title: Machine learning builds a plasma extracellular vesicle miRNA panel for laryngeal cancer
summary: Plasma small extracellular vesicle miRNAs from 6 laryngeal cancer patients and 3 controls were sequenced and compared with online datasets to build a five-miRNA panel by machine learning. An artificial neural network panel gave AUCs of 0.782, 1.000, 0.716 and 0.875 in independent datasets. In an independent qRT-PCR cohort of 84 people (48 patients, 36 controls) individual miRNA AUCs were 0.721-0.837 and a logistic model reached 0.959. The study is preliminary with small cohorts.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network miRNA panel with logistic model combination
organization: Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: Independent public datasets and an independent clinical qRT-PCR cohort of 84 participants.
evidence.unknown: Very small discovery sequencing set; final combination by logistic regression; preliminary; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Neural network panel built from miRNA expression for diagnosis and prognosis.
